title.narrative: for support of CAROL’s SRHR advocacy partnerships with NAYA, GLIHD, and RHNK

description.narrative: This grant will support the Center for Reproductive Rights Africa Regional Office (CAROL), an advocacy organization that utilizes strategic advocacy and communications, and high-impact litigation to build, defend, and enforce an enabling legal and policy environment for reproductive rights decisionmaking and access to services. Through core funding and capacity strengthening, CAROL will partner with Network for Adolescent and Youth of Africa (NAYA), Great Lakes Initiatives for Human Rights and Development (GLIHD), and Reproductive Health Network Kenya (RHNK) to advance protection for sexual and reproductive health and rights in Africa. (Strategy: Global Reproductive Equity)
